html.light .nex-hero, html.light .nex-hero-media { background: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; }

html.light .nex-hero-overlay { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 43%, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.05), rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.4) 60%, rgb(248, 250, 252)), linear-gradient(rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.35), rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.08) 36%, rgb(248, 250, 252)) !important; }
section:not(.nex-hero) { position: relative; }

section:not(.nex-hero)::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(142, 202, 230, 0.043), transparent 26%), linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), transparent 28%); opacity: 0.55; }
section:not(.nex-hero) > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.promo-ticker { line-height: 1; }
.promo-ticker-track { display: inline-flex; width: max-content; min-width: max-content; animation: 58s linear 0s infinite normal none running promoTicker; will-change: transform; }
.promo-ticker:hover .promo-ticker-track { animation-play-state: paused; }
.promo-ticker-group { display: inline-flex; width: max-content; min-width: max-content; }
.hero { min-height: 100vh; padding: 198px 24px 0px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; background: transparent; }
.hero > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.hero-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 31px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(253, 54, 107, 0.48); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0px 14px; background: rgba(253, 54, 107, 0.075); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset; }
.hero-pill span { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.hero h1 { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; max-width: 1060px; margin: 0px auto; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); font-size: clamp(48px, 5vw, 76px); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-shadow: none; }
.hero-title-line { display: block; white-space: nowrap; }
.hero-title-line:first-child { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 42%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98)) text; color: transparent; }
.hero h1 i { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); font-style: normal; }
.hero-copy { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 32px auto 0px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 34px; }
.growth-section { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: rgb(209, 213, 219); color: rgb(25, 26, 31); text-align: left; }
.growth-inner { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 720px; margin: 0px; overflow: hidden; padding: 102px 0px 0px; }
.growth-copy { position: relative; z-index: 3; width: min(100% - 48px, 1220px); max-width: none; margin: 0px auto; }

.growth-copy h2 { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; margin: 0px; max-width: 760px; color: rgb(26, 26, 26); font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 56px); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1.1; }
.growth-copy h2 span { display: block; color: gray; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; }
.growth-copy blockquote { max-width: 660px; margin: 30px 0px 0px; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 2px solid rgb(229, 231, 235); color: rgb(75, 85, 99); }
.growth-copy blockquote p { margin: 0px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }
.growth-copy cite { display: block; margin-top: 12px; color: rgb(26, 26, 26); font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.growth-chart { position: absolute; inset: 0px; z-index: 1; background: transparent; }

.growth-chart::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0px; bottom: 0px; width: 100%; height: 44%; background: rgba(29, 30, 35, 0.075); clip-path: polygon(0 100%,var(--growth-progress, 0%) calc(100% - var(--growth-progress, 0%)),var(--growth-progress, 0%) 100%); transition: clip-path 0.68s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
.growth-stat { position: absolute; z-index: 3; opacity: 0.24; transform: none; transition: opacity 0.24s, transform 0.24s; }

.growth-stat::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 2px; width: 1px; height: var(--drop-height); background: rgba(29, 30, 35, 0.32); transform: scaleY(0.35); transform-origin: center top; transition: transform 0.36s; }

.growth-stat::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0px; top: var(--drop-height); width: 1px; height: var(--tail-height); background: rgba(29, 30, 35, 0.14); transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: center top; transition: transform 0.52s 0.14s; }
.growth-stat.is-active { opacity: 1; }
.growth-stat.is-active::before, .growth-stat.is-active::after { transform: scaleY(1); }
.growth-stat strong { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; display: block; padding-left: 18px; color: rgb(26, 26, 26); font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.growth-stat span { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; display: block; margin-top: 5px; padding-left: 18px; color: rgb(107, 114, 128); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.growth-stat-1 { left: 19.5%; top: 426px; --drop-height: 28px; --tail-height: 194px; }
.growth-stat-2 { left: 35%; top: 358px; --drop-height: 28px; --tail-height: 214px; }
.growth-stat-3 { left: 50.5%; top: 290px; --drop-height: 28px; --tail-height: 232px; }
.growth-stat-4 { left: 66%; top: 222px; --drop-height: 28px; --tail-height: 252px; }
.promo-banner-container:hover .promo-scroll { animation-play-state: paused !important; }
